title: App Check
description: Firebase App Check: reCAPTCHA on web, App Attest / Play Integrity via RNFirebase on native.

EXPO_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY.description: reCAPTCHA v3 site key from Firebase console → App Check (web)

EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_CHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN.description: Optional debug token for local web development

markers.block:
['@react-native-firebase/app', { ios: { disableSPM: true } }],
    ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { useFrameworks: 'static', forceStaticLinking: ['RNFBApp', 'RNFBAnalytics', 'RNFBRemoteConfig', 'RNFBCrashlytics', 'RNFBPerf', 'RNFBAppCheck', 'RNFBFirestore', 'RNFBAuth', 'RNFBMessaging'] } }],

notes: Web uses reCAPTCHA (app-check.tsx); native uses app-check.native.tsx.
Enable enforcement per service in the Firebase console only after real traffic shows valid tokens.
Requires a development build and google-services files on native.
iOS uses CocoaPods Firebase (disableSPM) with static frameworks — required on Xcode 26+; SPM + dynamic hits SwiftUICore linker errors.
